family: GPRM Keehi IV and VI prestressed bridge girders

sources.edition: Undated sheets; issued/revised fields blank. PDF creation and modification metadata in 2010 do not establish a drawing issue date.

units: Source dimensions in inches; published area in in2, I in in4, moduli in in3, weight in kip/ft. Public geometry in mm.
geometry_notes: Wide profiles use the maximum printed widths: VI W 57 in; IV W 56.5 in. The 3 in edge is for the widest section. Unspecified project-specific narrowing is not modelled.
IV MOD adds 4 in at the top of IV, increasing the top edge from 4 to 8 in and total depth from 58 to 62 in.
All profiles retain both printed 3/4 in soffit chamfers and lower-web R=3/4 in fillets. Fillets are approximated with 64 straight segments per arc. Unlabelled upper corner radii are not inferred.

The published IV, IV W, IV MOD and VI W properties match the sharp nominal outline, excluding the drawn bevels and radii, to source rounding. Their as-drawn polygons have areas lower by 0.51-0.59 in2. Across all five profiles, including VI, the area deficits are 0.288-0.589 in2, Ixx is lower by 0.11-0.14 percent and yb is higher by 0.017-0.026 in. These source-convention differences are preserved rather than used to fit dimensions.

VI printed area 944 in2 rounds the nominal 944.25 in2; its as-drawn area is 943.711715 in2, giving a 0.288285 in2 deficit against the printed value. Printed Ixx 638894 in4 differs from the independently integrated sharp outline 638816.49 in4 by 0.012 percent.
Gross concrete only: reinforcing steel, strands, end-zone/block-out and project-specific details are excluded. Source availability is not proof of current production or design-standard applicability.
